# stratusphere/scripts/ops/Deploy-CidKey.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Rolls the Stratusphere Connector ID Key out to Azure VMs: AVD session hosts or any Windows VM.

Picks the targets (a host pool, a resource group, a tag or named VMs), skips what can't take the key (not running, not Windows), and runs scripts/agent/Invoke-CidKeyAction.ps1 on the rest through Azure Run Command, several machines at a time. -Action Plan (the default) only lists what would happen. Then: Check which machines have the key: present, degraded (and what is wrong) or absent. Install installs; skips machines that already have it unless -Force. Fix repairs: installs where absent, starts stopped services, reinstalls a half-installed key. -Force reinstalls healthy ones too (for example to point them at another Hub). Uninstall the installer's own uninstall. Cleanup uninstalls with whatever uninstaller exists and removes leftovers (services, settings key, program folders). For teardown and for broken machines. -FromReport <output/cid-rollout-*.json> reruns on the machines that did not end healthy last time, for example: -FromReport output/cid-rollout-20261015-221500.json -Action Fix ... Every machine downloads the installer from -InstallerUrl and verifies -InstallerSha256 before running it. Use the installer you downloaded from your own Hub (Hub Administration > Connector ID Keys), served from somewhere the machines can reach: for example a storage container with a short-lived SAS URL. The repo never ships it. Results go to the console, one line per machine, and to output/cid-rollout-<time>.json (git-ignored: it holds machine names). The last line is RESULT PASS or RESULT FAIL.

## Examples

```powershell
./scripts/ops/Deploy-CidKey.ps1 -HostPoolName hp-avdlz-dev -HostPoolResourceGroup rg-avdlz-dev-avd
```
```powershell
./scripts/ops/Deploy-CidKey.ps1 -HostPoolName hp-avdlz-dev -HostPoolResourceGroup rg-avdlz-dev-avd `
  -Action Install -HubAddress (address in the source) -InstallerUrl $url -InstallerSha256 $sha
```
